PHYSICAL SPACE: Interior of a brightly lit Costco wholesale warehouse store in the fresh food / deli department. XXX industrial ceiling with exposed ducts, hanging fluorescent lamps, polished concrete flooring, large stainless-steel rotisserie and deli counters with glass windows showing the kitchen interior behind. Multiple shoppers pushing carts in the wide aisles.

Nearby metal shopping carts containing groceries.
